name: ezai-code-formatter
description: Apply source file visual structure to match project conventions: section header comments, import ordering, spacing, and formatting — without touching logic.

capabilities.description: Add or replace main # /// and sub # --- section markers
stdlib → third-party → local, alphabetical within groups
Reorder class members: constructor → public → private
Remove redundant inline comments, preserve rationale
Auto-detect language from extension, route to style file
